titles.title: Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Reauthorization Act
Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Reauthorization Act
A bill to reauthorize the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
